WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES_MGMT.NO_WHATSAPP_INBOXES: No WhatsApp inboxes found. Create a WhatsApp inbox first.

STATUS_GUIDE.TITLE: Template Status Guide
STATUS_GUIDE.SUBTITLE: Understand what each status means and what to do in each situation

APPROVED.TITLE: Approved
APPROVED.DESCRIPTION: This template has been reviewed and approved by Meta. You can use it normally in broadcasts and automations.

PENDING.TITLE: In Analysis
PENDING.DESCRIPTION: Meta is reviewing this template. The process usually takes a few minutes up to 24 hours. It cannot be used until approved.

PAUSED.TITLE: Paused
PAUSED.DESCRIPTION: Meta paused this template automatically because it detected low read rates, many user complaints or blocks. This is temporary and lasts from 3 to 6 hours.
PAUSED.ACTION: Wait a few hours. Consider improving the content to avoid new pauses. After 3 pauses, the template is permanently disabled.

REJECTED.TITLE: Rejected
REJECTED.DESCRIPTION: Meta rejected this template for violating its policies. Check if the content contains spam, prohibited content or does not follow template guidelines.
REJECTED.ACTION: Edit the template correcting the problems or create a new one

EMPTY_STATE.TITLE: No templates found
EMPTY_STATE.SUBTITLE: Create your first WhatsApp template to get started.

NAME.LABEL: Template Name
NAME.HELP: Lowercase alphanumeric characters and underscores only

BODY.LABEL: Message Body
BODY.PLACEHOLDER: Type your message here. Add variables with double curly braces.
BODY.HELP: Wrap variable names in double curly braces, e.g. first_name or 1

API.SUCCESS_MESSAGE: Template created successfully. It will be reviewed by WhatsApp.
